critical.issue: REGRESSION — returns 400 'Invalid event type. Must be one of: engagement, haldi, mehendi, marriage, reception'. The route at server.py:6446 is registered AFTER the catch-all '/invite/{slug}/{event_type}' (server.py:4424), so FastAPI dispatches the request to the catch-all instead of the calendar handler. Verified with: curl https://wedding-invite-hub-19.preview.emergentagent.com/api/invite/aarav-and-riya-demo/calendar -> HTTP 400 application/json. Fix: register an alias (or move the existing route) BEFORE line 4424, exactly the same pattern already used for the /songs alias at line 4400.

critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering: `/invite/{slug}/{event_type}` at server.py:4424 is a hungry catch-all that intercepts every sibling under /invite/{slug}/.... The /songs alias was correctly placed before it; the same care is needed for ANY future /invite/{slug}/<word> route. Consider either changing event_type to a literal/regex path param or moving every sibling endpoint above this catch-all. Today /calendar (6446) is broken because of this exact issue. Long-term, replace the catch-all with explicit Literal['engagement','haldi','mehendi','marriage','reception'] in the path so unknown sub-paths cleanly fall through to other registered routes.

models.py SongRequestSettings.max_per_guest is read as `int(settings.get('max_per_guest', 3) or 3)` — fine, but the same defaulting is not applied to other Bucket 1A settings. Consider centralising defaults in the Pydantic model.

server.py:5473 dup_q for check-in uses `guest_name: payload.guest_name.strip()` raw — for case-insensitive dedupe consider matching on `.lower()` (the `name_key` variable is built but never used). Currently 'Riya' and 'riya' produce two distinct check-ins within the 30-min window.

rca of the issue: REGRESSION RCA — /api/invite/{slug}/calendar: FastAPI matches routes by *registration order*. The Bucket 1A implementation correctly added the /songs alias at server.py:4400, immediately BEFORE the catch-all `/invite/{slug}/{event_type}` at server.py:4424. However the pre-existing /calendar route at server.py:6446 was never moved or aliased, so the catch-all swallows it first and rejects 'calendar' as an invalid event_type with HTTP 400. Reproduction: `curl -i https://wedding-invite-hub-19.preview.emergentagent.com/api/invite/aarav-and-riya-demo/calendar` -> `400 {"detail":"Invalid event type. Must be one of: engagement, haldi, mehendi, marriage, reception"}`. Mitigation: add `@api_router.get('/invite/{slug}/calendar') ...` (or just move the existing definition) above line 4424, mirroring the /songs alias pattern. No data or business logic change required.
